_comment: v2 source set (Trellis2 regen 2026-07-26). Each glb is unit-normalised (longest axis = 1.0) and centred. Source orientations, read off the orientation sheets: body +X=muzzle/+Z=up; magazine +Z=feed/+X=fore-aft; scope -Y=objective/+Z=up; muzzle -Y=exit. Target = CP77 weapon frame: +Y=muzzle, +Z=up, +X=right. All axis maps have determinant +1 (no mirroring - the old v1 config mirrored every part).
